median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the 2017 census's population by age and sex (the Fiji Bureau of Statistics' tabulation in PopGIS, published by OCHA as COD-PS). The Bureau publishes a median only for Fiji as a whole, 27.5 years.
sex_ratio_note: Males per 100 females, 2017 census, from the same table.
religion_note: Religion at the 2007 census, the latest by province: Table P01-3 of the Fiji Bureau of Statistics (by province of enumeration). The 2017 census has published no religion table: the word appears on none of the 484 pages of its Administrative Report and General Tables, and its Release 1 covers age, sex, geography and economic activity. The table prints no religion for 557 of the 342,594 people here, and they are in no share. The division's provinces added up: Naitasiri, Namosi, Rewa, Serua, Tailevu.
ethnicity_note: Ethnicity at the 2007 census, the latest by province: Table P01-3 of the Fiji Bureau of Statistics (by province of enumeration). The 2017 census has published no ethnicity table: its Administrative Report and General Tables (484 pages) tabulate no ethnic group, and its Release 1 covers age, sex, geography and economic activity. The census's "Fijian" is the indigenous iTaukei people and its "Indian" the Indo-Fijian community, named here as they are today. The division's provinces added up: Naitasiri, Namosi, Rewa, Serua, Tailevu.
